notes.title: Asbak - New patch is coming!
notes.notes:
Here's our first patch in Asbak!! Thank you so much for all the feedback so far, which inspired us to develop some improvements and fixes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013467/627fc653bf3e1dbe840adbd048b0c152b3b9c4b8.png

Hey'all! Publisher here, we would like to introduce you into our world and be the best exorcist to save the city. You know... the demons and stuff like that really... haunting people more frequently. So, we keep improving to make sure you are the best among the best exorcist in Mandraguna LTD.

So, what's the change so far? Very well, look at these!

Note: 📢 indicates a change inspired by community feedback! (Almost everything in this case...!)

General Gameplay
📢 Score system fixed (yeah, previously the score always reset when you change rooms)
📢 Controller mapping (if you want to change by yourself to suit with your playstyle, go to settings)
📢 Controller improvements for better experience
📢 Bug fixes in certain aspects

Level Design & Environments
📢 Bug fixes on the levels (Previously, we locked into a room after defeating the demons, and that's scary)
📢 New items appeared!

Characters
📢 Pak Asep, the old man, now can attack with his summoned guard as normal attack, while attacking by skulls, was set as charged attack/heavy attack that needs energy

Menu
📢 Bug fixes on menu while using gamepad
📢 Choosing menu is even clearer with text background

Last update from us
As per May 20th 2024, this will be our last demo about Asbak that can be accessed publicly, we'll push forward to full build game and you can expect more about the story, the dialogue, new characters, new items, new features, and more. 

We'll update the info, so you won't miss the excitement!
